subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Alex / Priya — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC ready:

Success criteria (what we agreed to measure):
- Latency: median response time for gen endpoints <= 200ms (p99 target TBD)
- Cost: target unit cost < $0.005 per 1k token-equivalent for your baseline workload
- Quality: top-3 results for embedding-based search match your labeled set >= 85% precision
- Reliability: no more than 2 incidents impacting availability during the 2-week POC

Evaluation plan + timeline:
- Jan 19: finalize access & security checklist (IP allowlist, SSO SAML)
- Jan 20: provision test API key / SSO invites, kickoff POC (2 weeks: Jan 20–Feb 3)
- Week 1: functional validation (integration, inference correctness)
- Week 2: perf/cost testing (throughput/latency, batching profiles)

POC ownership:
- Acme product lead: Alex Johnson (your side)
- Acme security: Priya Shah (security/compliance)
- Redwood POC lead: Marissa Cole (me)
- Support & perf: Rishi Malhotra (solutions engineering)

Access items we need from Acme to proceed:
1) SSO: SAML metadata / IdP contact for SSO invite (if you prefer, we can send an invite to your IdP admin)
2) IP allowlist: public egress ranges where requests will originate (we will provide Redwood allowlist too)
3) Procurement contact for the PO/contract (we can route DocuSign)

What we will provide upon completion of the minimal security checklist:
- POC API credentials (delivered via a secure channel)
- POC onboarding doc and sample requests (attached: redwood-poc-setup.pdf)
- Test dataset requirements (attached: acme-data-reqs.xlsx)

Action items:
- Alex: confirm procurement contact (name + email) and SSO admin for IdP metadata by EOD Mon (Jan 19)
- Priya: confirm any additional security docs you want (SOC2 + data flow diagram)
- Marissa: will provision placeholders and coordinate SSO invite once we have IdP info

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-poc-setup.pdf
Attachment: acme-data-reqs.xlsx

Looping in to offer support on perf and scale testing. A couple notes from the SE side:
- For realistic perf tests we'll want a small synthetic workload that mirrors your production token lengths and concurrency. If you can share a sampled request distribution (or use the attached sample), we can run with that.
- If the POC needs consistent high throughput during the test window, consider a short Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) for the perf week — we can spin a 2-GPU pool for the two-day perf window to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
- I'll prepare a simple JMeter script and a cost/latency runbook for your team.

Happy to join the kickoff Jan 20 and run the initial perf checks.

—Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
